svg.title: simulate — generate dated histories from the current model
svg.desc: A model that cannot simulate, a start before the retained histories, a non-state intervention target or a diverging log-link mean fails the call. Otherwise 100 draws are generated from the resolved start state and checked; with interventions, a certified effect is summarized, and the report commits without changing the model.

g.text: the model cannot execute or simulate
start before the first retained state
an intervention target is not a latent state
retained joint state at or before start, advanced to it
without retained histories: the initial-state law
interventions add a paired reference history
dynamics: C1a C1b C2 C3 C4c · emissions: C5c
not evaluated: C4b edge contrasts · C5a C5b need observed data
Summarize the effect on the outcome
info: checks not evaluated · effect not reportable
